name: chart-parts
title: Chart parts
description: The shared frame (with its data table), legend and tooltip the charts are built from, plus the CHART_COLORS series palette, for a custom chart.

when: Building a chart the library does not have, so it looks and reads like the others.

instead.when: Bars and lines on one plot cover the need without custom parts.

builtIn: A "Show as table" button shows the same data as a table, which screen readers get by default.
youProvide: A title that says what the figure is.
